Open the relevant recruitment notification - "Vacancy Notice No. 33/2026" or "Vacancy Notice No. 32/2026" - depending on the post you wish to apply for.
Go through the eligibility, age criteria, and other conditions carefully before proceeding.
Register first; on successful registration, an application number/login ID and password will be generated and sent to your email and mobile number.
From 10.09.2026 onward, log in and fill the application form with all details (age, personal details, educational qualification, etc.).

Upload a recent passport-size colour photo (100–200 KB, JPG/JPEG), a recent scanned signature (80–150 KB, JPG/JPEG), and category/caste certificates plus educational and other certificates (100–1000 KB, JPG/JPEG/PDF).
Preview the application form carefully - once submitted, it cannot be edited.
Complete the fee payment (if applicable) via Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking; only after successful payment will a payment acknowledgment with a unique application number be generated.
Submit the application before 09.10.2026 (23:55 hrs); it is advised to apply at least two days before the closing date to avoid transaction failures.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is assessed as on the cut-off date, 10.09.2026. Only Full Time Regular Courses are considered; only Indian Nationals above 18 years of age are eligible. For Post Codes C07 and C08, a B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) (Full Time) in the relevant discipline is also permitted in place of the Diploma. For Post Codes C09 and C10, the ITI qualification is mandatory - a higher qualification will not be considered as a substitute. For Post Codes D02 to D05, a B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) (Full Time) in the relevant discipline is also permitted in place of the Diploma. For Post Codes D06 to D09, the ITI qualification is mandatory. All qualifications must be from a UGC-recognised Indian University/Deemed University or an AICTE-approved course from an autonomous Indian institution. Where CGPA/OGPA/CPI or a grade is awarded, the equivalent percentage as per the University/Institute's norms must be indicated in the application.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for all posts under both notices is 28 years , as on 10.09.2026. Cumulative relaxation for candidates falling under more than one category is admissible. However, the maximum upper age of any candidate shall not exceed 50 years, including all possible age relaxations. Ex-servicemen relaxation is also capped at a maximum age of 50 years. NCRTC employees who have completed one year of service as on the date of the notice get age relaxation to the extent of completed years of service, plus relaxation in the Full-Time qualification requirement. Candidates from SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD categories who apply against unreserved posts will not get the benefit of age relaxation or relaxed qualifying marks at any stage of the process. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates will receive Variable Dearness Allowance (VDA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and Perks and Allowances under the Cafeteria Approach, plus other benefits as per extant Company Rules.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: UR, OBC (NCL), EWS and Ex-Servicemen category candidates: ₹500 (non-refundable), exclusive of transaction processing charges and GST. SC, ST and PwBD category candidates: No fee. Fee once paid, including transaction charges and GST, is non-refundable under any circumstances. Candidates applying for more than one post must pay the application fee separately for each post. Payment modes: Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection under both notices follows a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Medical Fitness Test. The CBT will have 100 questions for 100 marks; each correct answer carries 1 mark, and there is no negative marking for wrong answers. Duration of the CBT is 90 minutes, available in Hindi or English (candidate's choice). Minimum qualifying percentage: 60% for UR/OBC (NCL)/EWS; 50% for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen. Final selection is on merit basis beyond the qualifying marks. Candidates give a preference of 5 cities for their Test Centre; no change is permitted later. Test Centre options include Delhi-NCR, Lucknow, Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kanpur, Agra, Vadodara, Indore, Thane, Pune, Guwahati, Raipur (Chhattisgarh), Cuttack, Harohalli, Jaipur, and Patiala. Candidates applying for multiple posts should note that CBTs for different posts may clash in date/time - a candidate can appear in the CBT for one post only in such cases. Medical standards follow the Indian Railway Medical Manual (IRMM). Lasik surgery or any form of radial keratotomy for vision correction is not permitted. Expenses for the first medical examination are borne by NCRTC; a second/re-examination, if required, is at the candidate's own expense.

content_sections.heading: NCRTC Recruitment 2026 Surety Bond & Employment Terms
content_sections.text: Under Notice 33/2026, the term of contract is 5 years from the date of appointment; these posts are purely on contract basis and do not confer any right to regularization. Under Notice 32/2026 (Direct Recruitment), selected candidates undergo a probation period of 2 years as per Company policy. In both cases, a one-month prior notice is required on either side before resignation/termination, and selected candidates will undergo on-the-job training of a duration decided by NCRTC.

faq.question: Q1. What is NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It refers to two Vacancy Notices released by National Capital Region Transport Corporation on 10.09.2026 - No. 33/2026 for Supervisors and Non-Supervisors on contract basis, and No. 32/2026 for Operations & Maintenance Staff on direct recruitment basis - for its Namo Bharat Project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 90 vacancies in total: 23 under Notice No. 33/2026 and 67 under Notice No. 32/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for both notices is 09.10.2026, up to 23:55 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years as on 10.09.2026, with relaxations of up to 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and up to 15 years for PwBD-SC/ST candidates. The overall upper age cap after all relaxations is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UR, OBC (NCL), EWS and Ex-Servicemen candidates must pay ₹500 (non-refundable, plus transaction charges and GST). SC, ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NCRTC Supervisor and Junior Maintainer posts?
faq.answer: Supervisor-I (Level S1) posts carry a pay scale of ₹37,000–₹1,15,000 with initial basic pay of ₹37,000. Junior Maintainer (Level NS3) posts carry ₹18,250–₹59,200 with initial basic pay of ₹18,250, plus VDA, HRA and other allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 100 questions/100 marks with no negative marking, followed by a Medical Fitness Test as per Indian Railway Medical Manual standards.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for NCRTC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must visit www.ncrtc.in, register, then fill the online application form for the relevant Vacancy Notice (32/2026 or 33/2026), upload required documents, pay the fee (if applicable), and submit before the closing date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the difference between Notice No. 32/2026 and Notice No. 33/2026?
faq.answer: Notice No. 33/2026 is for Supervisors and Non-Supervisors on contract (regular pay scale) basis with a 5-year contract term and no right to regularization. Notice No. 32/2026 is for Operations & Maintenance Staff on direct recruitment basis, involving a 2-year probation period.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a surety bond for selected NCRTC candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. Supervisor-level selected candidates must execute a surety bond of ₹4,00,000 to serve NCRTC for a minimum of 3 years; Non-Supervisor (Junior Maintainer) candidates must execute a bond of ₹3,00,000 for the same minimum period, under both notices.
